title: Patrick Ta Beauty shakes up leadership team with CMO and Creative VP appointments
summary: The cosmetics brand, founded by make-up artist Patrick Ta, said the new appointments of Angela Simpson as Chief Marketing Officer and Carolyne Rapp as VP of Creative build on its current momentum and positioning
